title: ANDS Studio — Overall impression
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio · guided ANDS filing." The brand sits beside a horizontal nav of icon-labelled chips — "Journey," "Dossiers," "Portfolio," "Registry," "Correspondence," and "Help" — each carrying a small icon (a folder-tree for Dossiers, a badge for Registry, an envelope for Correspondence, a book for Help). The active route is highlighted. A user chip sits at the far right. If no prior session exists, the hero shows; a one-time external-prerequisites checklist can appear first and, once you begin, gives way to the hero.

The headline reads "File your ANDS with Health Canada — guided end to end." The body copy states an Abbreviated New Drug Submission is one of the most complex filings a company can make, and that this walks you through it step by step — every term explained in plain language with the regulatory vocabulary kept precise, the right pathway chosen for your product, and readiness visible at every moment until it's ready to send. The primary button is "Start my submission →." Below it, two chips read "Managing several products? Open the dossier catalog →" (with a count when dossiers exist) and "Portfolio roll-up →" (with an "in progress" count when any are blocked). A line notes bilingual Module 1 and Product Monograph (EN + FR) status live inside each dossier, and a footnote reads "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically." Returning later shows "Loading your filing…" and resumes your saved session.

Starting opens a three-column layout: a step rail of journey stages on the left, the active step's card in the middle, and a right-hand panel with a "submission tower" of module tiles plus a readiness card. The top bar gains a readiness chip — "Ready to file" or a percentage like "34% ready" — and a "Start over" button. On the content stage, a "Labelling / Product Monograph" card notes bilingual Module 1 and the EN + FR Product Monograph are a transmission blocker if either is missing, and links to a dossier's Module 1.

Help opens a "Regulatory reference" page. It explains these are the primary Health Canada sources behind everything the app checks and generates, that every in-app review finding links to one, and that all links go to canada.ca or laws-lois.justice.gc.ca. Cards are grouped under "Filing an ANDS — the core references," "Generic-specific," and "Transmitting & after approval," each an outbound link with a plain note. A "How validation works here" section lists rule-ID families (CA-E-1xxx through 4xxx, an XML backbone, PDF conformance, and CA-REP-0001) and pulls the complete rule catalogue live from the engine, grouped into expandable families with a rule count. A "How AI drafting is controlled" section states drafting is opt-in per ✦AI section, nothing saves until you click "Use this draft," every AI-assisted document is permanently labelled and recorded in an append-only audit trail, and the human review plus e-signature gate still stands before transmission. A closing tip notes dashed-underlined terms reveal definitions on hover.

The Roadmap page states plainly that anything listed is not available today, with honest target quarters. Each card names a capability, a "Target" chip marked "in design" or "planned," and a short detail, with a "← Back to sign in" link at the bottom.
